name: Red Remover
author: Addicting Games
description: Red Remover is a free puzzle game where your objective is to remove the red blocks. Enjoy this fun brain teaser game with its cute and simple animation. The red blocks are miserable and they just want to go away. Your job is to do this while leaving the green and happy blocks on the screen. Lose a green block, and you lose that level! This is a creative puzzle game where you have to think of various ways to keep the green blocks safe. Some of them may be in danger are about to roll off the screen but you can use other blocks to safeguard them. There are 40 levels to solve in this funny puzzle game along with more locked levels.
